sampling_selection_note: Forwarding fixed; greedy was tested explicitly and NOT selected as the production default. Service restarted after trials to restore startup sampler defaults. Default UI configuration now reaches the native sampler.
vision_exact_frame_cache_note: One per-session frame; explicit single-slice input and byte equality required. Vision token count and embeddings are preserved. No promise of camera hit rate.
vocoder_warmup_note: Run a standalone 50-mel-frame HiFiGAN2 graph at startup when CPU BLAS is enabled. No prompt, flow RNG or stream-state mutation.
native_hidden_ownership_note: Release the malloc-owned LLM hidden copy after each token has been copied into the TTS vector. Fixed-token Q4 logits and TTS hidden states are byte-identical. This removes a measured leak; no latency speedup is claimed.
tts_decoder_placement_note: Original F16 Metal decoder and F16 KV retained. CPU standard/Flash trials failed declared numerical checks; four-worker trial had residual underflow. Full 4096-token causal attention retained.
t2w_full_path_warmup_note: Two unchanged 25+3 Flow/vocoder windows at startup; discard PCM, restore all noise generators and pristine prompt/stream. Fixed 90240-sample PCM baseline/modified/rollback is byte-identical.
baseline_status: Apple M5 baseline preserved; long-session continuity and speech quality acceptance remain incomplete.
